items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: He tells everybody that Zutty's his oldest friend. ... we had to see each other, talk to each other every day and we'd have dinner together. And we were really a foursome.

ctx.x: Yes. And see in California, like he tells everybody, he tells everybody. He says, we had to see each other, talk to each other every day and we'd have dinner together. And I'd cook or MARALEE'S would cook. And we were really a foursome. And on Thanksgiving we had a dinner at their home and ever Oh Christmas they had dinner over at our home. It was an annual affair.
Yes. MARALEE'S mother and father would come.

Yes, would come too. And Ertcgan (Hertigan?) and I used to gamble together a lot. He loved to play poker and I did too. We'd go to these poker games together you know, yes. And he would pick me up and we'd play poker all night. And then play poker all night at my house whenever I'd have a party. (LAUGHTER). And we just were really, he tells everybody that Zutty's his oldest friend.
